definitions.ask: Should the five docs pages be trimmed to 5800 words or fewer instead of just under the 6000 cap?
definitions.why: These pages were pushed back over the cap five times in two weeks.

choices.label: Trim each page to 5800 words or fewer so concurrent epics do not immediately re-trip the cap
Trim only to just under 6000, preserving the most existing prose

definitions.ask: May the docs phase split a section into a new mounted reference page when trimming would drop facts?
definitions.why: Every page is only 1-4% over the cap; deduplication reaches target without IA/URL risk.

choices.label: Trim duplicated prose only; a page that cannot reach target keeping its facts is reported
Split one coherent section into its own mounted page, preserving existing published URLs

definitions.ask: Should the created-offset phase also make an RFC 3339 BOB_NOW with an explicit offset be honored?
definitions.why: The documented RFC 3339 form silently falls back to the clock; the worker is already in that file.

choices.label: Fix BOB_NOW parsing to honor an explicit offset, with its own regression test
Only investigate and record findings on bob-cli-k8 for a follow-up
